parts.name: Handle
parts.description: The handle of the tap, made of brass, is the part users grip to control water flow.

parts.name: Packing Nut
parts.description: A brass nut located below the handle, securing the stem and preventing leaks.

parts.name: Wall Flange
parts.description: A circular brass plate that covers the joint between the tap and the wall.

parts.name: Tap Body
parts.description: The main body of the tap, made of brass, which houses the valve and connects to the water supply.
